svg.title: Pipeline hazard timing

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each row is one instruction, each column one clock cycle. Simplified: the fetch unit's buffering is not shown.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · Data dependence on an ALU result — forwarded, no stall

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The result exists at the end of EX, so the next instruction takes it straight from the EX/MEM register.

svg.text: 2 · Load followed by its consumer — one bubble

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A loaded value exists only at the end of MEM. The consumer waits one cycle in ID, then takes the value from MEM/WB.

svg.text: 3 · Mispredicted branch — checked in EX, redirected from MEM

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A correctly predicted branch costs nothing. A misprediction is found in EX, the redirect fires from MEM, and the three instructions behind it are squashed.
